kind: private coding, Reviewer and sustained-workflow diagnostic
baseline: The frozen fresh review-queue task failed original API, CSV, PATCH and Edit compatibility despite a narrow new-review UI pass; see 2026-09-29-fresh-review-queue-owner-failure.json. The first regressions were introduced before context was full, so this is not evidence of a 96K overflow.

default.result: Read task, implementation summary, production source and model-written tests. Found a real duplicate status label but missed the four material original-behavior regressions; also invented or overstated findings and concluded no regressions detected.

higher_thinking_budget.result: Read more source and reports but still missed all four material regressions and returned unrelated or incorrect findings. Increasing reasoning budget did not improve this case.

browser_trial.result: Detected missing Edit and export HTTP 400, but incorrectly passed exact entries API shape and inferred import success from visible controls without uploading a file. Browser-agent reports are observations, not independent acceptance.

test_first_trial.status: INCOMPLETE; operator stopped repeated different check commands whose fallback or pipeline hid failures
test_first_trial.result: The model-written preservation test failed the untouched baseline because its server readiness loop did not wait and its CSV assertion mishandled CRLF. Correcting those test-only bugs in a disposable copy made all three tests pass on baseline and fail on the known bad app. The model-generated test did not qualify unassisted.

staged_repair.setup: Operator-supplied disposable three-case HTTP contract test, proven green on original fixture and red on failed artifact; candidate KRYN plugin; guarded local 9B; no browser tool in this scoped first stage.
staged_repair.independent_result: Three contract, two original and twelve model-written review tests passed. Frozen API oracle passed 17 checks. Both browser oracles failed: review 503 had no new accessible status, and original Edit was absent. An additional independent review-then-PATCH probe showed PATCH reset review state to pending.

resumed_ui_repair.setup: New native server process resumed the same saved session with a fourth operator-supplied contract test for review state across PATCH, browser tools and candidate KRYN plugin.
resumed_ui_repair.status: INCOMPLETE; operator stopped after repeated unsuccessful persistent-server launch attempts; no native browser acceptance or compaction occurred
resumed_ui_repair.independent_final: Four contract, two original and twelve review tests passed; frozen API oracle passed 17 checks; review browser passed initial pending filter then failed accessible 503 feedback; Task12 browser passed nine preceding checks including Edit, both viewports, import and retry, then failed because two buttons had the exact accessible name Filter.

product_fix: KRYN now stops an Agent turn after three masked-check denials in one prompt, resets the counter after a completed standalone check or new prompt, and records the policy-loop trigger in a private incident. This bounds the observed waste without changing the model or Reviewer claims. A focused regression, 196 Python tests, 78 JavaScript tests, frozen-suite self-checks and candidate package smoke passed.
decision: Autonomous coding/UI, Reviewer accuracy, and successful sustained-workflow gates remain FAIL. The provided-tests repair is assisted evidence only; the resumed turn did not finish, and there were no two native compactions or 45–60-minute successful active run. Keep releases and version bumps paused; do not infer frontier-equivalent quality.
